# googleads_campaign_shared_set (Resource)

Attaches a `googleads_shared_set` to a `googleads_campaign`. Both endpoints are immutable per the API; the link has no update operation, so any change forces resource replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_campaign_shared_set" "attach_brand_negatives" {
  customer_id   = "1234567890"
  campaign_id   = googleads_campaign.search.id
  shared_set_id = googleads_shared_set.brand_negatives.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Campaign resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `shared_set_id` (String) Shared set resource name. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/campaignSharedSets/{campaign_id}~{shared_set_id}).
- `status` (String) Output-only link status (ENABLED, REMOVED).
